description: Adds one participant to a DRAFT signature request. This is the ONLY participant create endpoint: `role` selects SIGNATORY (must sign), OBSERVER (receives a read-only copy) or VALIDATOR (must approve before its signatory can sign; only if your company's plan allows validators, else 409 SignatureValidatorsNotAllowed). Requires: signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId, plus role, firstName, lastName and email. YOU generate `id` (UUID v4) and the call returns HTTP 201 with NO body, so nothing is handed back — the id you generated IS the participantId, and it is the signatoryId if you passed role SIGNATORY or the validatorId if you passed role VALIDATOR. Keep it. For ADVANCED signatures phonePrefix and phoneNumber are mandatory because the signer receives the OTP there, and WhatsApp delivery is NOT supported for ADVANCED; for INTERPOSITION and WITH_CERTIFICATE the phone is optional, and sendWaUrl (WhatsApp) or sendSmsUrl (SMS, where the platform enables it) also sends the link there. Add at least one SIGNATORY before activating. For role VALIDATOR do NOT include groupId or linkToAllDocuments — link it afterwards with assign_validator_to_signatory. Use signature_participant_add_bulk to add many at once, and signature_participant_list to re-read what exists.

sendSmsUrl.description: Also send this signatory the signing link by SMS (RCS), where the platform enables SMS links. Only for role SIGNATORY on an INTERPOSITION or WITH_CERTIFICATE request: the API rejects it for ADVANCED requests and for observers and validators. Needs phonePrefix (with its leading +, e.g. +34) and phoneNumber.

sendWaUrl.description: Also send this signatory the signing link by WhatsApp. Only for role SIGNATORY on an INTERPOSITION or WITH_CERTIFICATE request: the API rejects it for ADVANCED requests and for observers and validators. Needs phonePrefix (with its leading +, e.g. +34) and phoneNumber.

name: signature_participant_create
